notes.title: Stars in the Trash 1.04 Live Now
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*]  In the supermarket, if Moka released the apple from the ceiling pipes, it would go through the floor, blocking progress and making it necessary to repeat the scene.

Happy two month anniversary!

notes.title: Stars in the Trash 1.03 Live Now and What's Next
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Slightly extended attack range to make interaction with objects easier.
[*] Fixed a bug in the last checkpoint of the Waste Ground level that caused an incorrect rat count and a possible blockage. 
[*] Now entering chapter selection does not reset the last checkpoint.
[*] When you reach the Bridge level, Waste Ground is unlocked from the level selector (previously you had to reach the Gothic Quarter).
[*] In the blanket section, once Ursus appears you can't go back.
[*] Minor graphic and audio corrections.
[/list]

If we could expand the world of Stars in the Trash, what things would you like to see in it?

You can leave me your thoughts and comments in this anonymous [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdcG2Bcz7NlsSdyEATMQTiAPozgC7BBm2GEAER9jZpWD2boaw/viewform?usp=header]form[/url].

Jose

notes.title: Stars in the Trash 1.02 Live Now
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Starting a new game unnecessarily warned players about losing progress, even when no progress exists.
[*] From the chapter selection menu, a scene could be loaded several times in a row, causing a malfunction (Goodbye Flying Moka).
[*] Exiting to the main menu did not stop the vibration and some sounds continued to play.
[*] In the tower, Ursus now runs faster from one window to another. If Moka reached the last window before Ursus, the sprites were duplicated.
[*] Volume settings are saved between game sessions.
[*] In the dolmen area, if you ate the catnip looking to the right Moka went through a collider and went out of the map.
[*] Minor changes in colliders and sprites.  
[/list]

Thank you all very much for reporting bugs and making Stars in the Trash a better game. 

Jose

notes.title: Stars in the Trash 1.01 Live Now
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Flashing lights warning for photosensitive people. I'm really sorry, I didn't realize this could be a problem. Now You can disable the flashing lights from the accessibility menu.
[*] Fixed the bug that allowed to break the glass of the supermarket by dropping the apple near it.
[*] The truck can ram us when we are escaping from it.
[*] Moka can't meow when he is carrying an object in his mouth.
[*] Corrected the depth of some layers in the forest.
[*] Corrected the collider of the burrow, that allowed to go out of the map.
[*] In the tower level, removed a ledge that was between the clouds and shouldn't be there.
[/list]

Known things:
[list]
[*] When Moka jumps or rolls from a puddle to dry ground, he doesn't shake his hind leg to shake the water. This is something I would like to keep.
[*] During most scenes Moka can meow. This should not be allowed, but several people have asked me not to remove it. Since it is optional I have decided to keep it.
[/list]

Thank you all very much for reporting bugs and making Stars in the Trash a better game. 

Merry Christmas!

Jose

notes.title: Valhalla Cats and IndieArk have officially partnered!
notes.content:
Hi fam!

We are very happy to announce that Valhalla Cats has officially partnered with Chinese publisher IndieArk! After the game's demo and store page were announced, we've gotten a lot of attention from players from all over the world, and we're very happy about it! (And so is TIKA).

We've found that cat culture has a very deep influence in Asia, with so many funny cat videos on Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Twitter and Youtube. We love the game we created so much, and we hope that this love can be conveyed to more players in Asia through these platforms!

With the help of IndieArk, more languages will be available in the game, more feedback will be collected from Asian players and more players will be able to learn about Stars in the Trash.

Finally, don't forget to watch our new trailer!

notes.title: Pet Contest! Feature your pet in game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642084/4b595593dc2b65ae5f561b7ae359f8466813d054.png[/img]

Fam, you've shown us so much love over the years that we wanted to show our appreciation with a very special contest: Your pet can appear in Stars in the Trash! Yes, you heard it right. Select the best photos of your cat, dog, bird, fish, spider, you name it, and participate! Some pets will be selected at random and others by number of votes.

Moreover, on the occasion of the Steam Next Fest the demo will be available again from today until the end of the contest.

All the details in this FAQ:

[b]How can I participate?[/b]

As simple as uploading a photo of your pet through the form on the page: [url=https://pr.easypromosapp.com/p/977884]Pet Contest Link[/url]  💌

[b]What are the prizes?[/b]

There are 6 prizes divided into two categories:

Category 1: Your pet will be featured in Star in the Trash video game as a NPC (Non-Player Character).

Category 2: A poster of your pet will be featured in Star in the Trash video game.

[b]How are the winners chosen?[/b]

The 1st and 2nd most voted pets win a category 1 prize.
The 3rd and 4th most voted pets win a category 2 prize.

In order to give all pets a chance to appear in the game, one prize from each category will be randomly raffled among all participants.

[b]How often can I vote?[/b]

You can vote once a day.

[b]When is the contest over?[/b]

The promotion will run from 05/25/2024 at 00:00 GMT+1 to 06/23/2024 at 23:59 GMT+1

[b]How can I increase my chances of winning?[/b]

Share with friends so you can get more votes.
If many people add Stars in the Trash to their wishlist we will increase the number of prizes.

[h2]Wishlist Star in the Trash[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822240/Stars_In_The_Trash/


Do you have any questions? Write us at valhallacats@gmail.com
